| STEP | WHAT TO DO | OWNER | CONTROL / OUTPUT |  |  |  |  |
| 1 | Maintain each legal employer once in 01\_COMPANIES. | HR / Payroll | Company Code is the canonical employer key. |  |  |  |  |
| 2 | Maintain each employee once in 02\_EMPLOYEES. Set Pay Basis = Monthly or Daily, then maintain Monthly Basic or Daily Wage Rate as applicable. | HR / Payroll | Employee ID is the canonical employee key. |  |  |  |  |
| 3 | For each payroll month, add one row per employee in 03\_PAYROLL. | Payroll | One Employee ID + one payroll period = one payroll record. |  |  |  |  |
| 4 | For each payroll month, enter attendance/paid days, variable earnings, deductions and official statutory amounts in yellow cells. Monthly regular pay uses full/prorated monthly rate; Daily regular pay uses Daily Wage Rate × Paid Working Days. | Payroll | All calculations are visible in the same payroll row. |  |  |  |  |
| 5 | Review the Calculation Check, then set Status to Reviewed / Approved / Paid. | Reviewer / Approver | Payslip can issue only when Calculation Check = OK and Status is Approved/Paid. |  |  |  |  |
| 6 | Select Payroll ID in 04\_PAYSLIP and print/share the employee statement. | Payroll / HR | Payslip shows earnings, deductions, employer contributions and calculation basis. |  |  |  |  |
